capabilities: Chat with a chosen LLM in a sidepanel
Search, read, create, append, and rewrite vault notes via agent tools
Attach the active note as chat context
Insert, copy, or save AI responses as notes
Configure provider, model, API key, and system prompt
extras: Installation instructions cover only a development build (clone, build, copy manifest.json/main.js/styles.css into the vault plugin directory); no released version or BRAT-style install is mentioned. Agent tool access is toggleable with a configurable maximum tool iteration depth.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, and using an external assistant means manually copying note text out and pasting results back in.

requires.name: An LLM provider API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, or custom endpoint)
Ollama, LM Studio, LocalAI, or vLLM for local offline models

summary: AI sidebar plugin that connects to any LLM provider and reads, searches, and writes vault notes through autonomous agent tools.
